self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Strong Strike (fixed value — Predator is capped at Refinement 1, only one copy was ever obtainable so there is no R5 tier): dealing Cryo DMG increases Normal and Charged Attack DMG by 10% for 6s, max 2 stacks. Modeled at max stacks (+20%). The Aloy-exclusive flat +66 ATK bonus is not modeled since it only applies when Aloy specifically wields this weapon.

en.flavor: A uniquely-designed bow. This should not belong in this world.

refinements.1:
<v>Effective only on the following platform: </v>
<v>"PlayStation™Network"</v>
Dealing Cryo DMG to opponents increases this character's Normal and Charged Attack DMG by 10% for 6s. This effect can have a maximum of 2 stacks. Additionally, when Aloy equips Predator, ATK is increased by 66.

fr.flavor: Un arc à la conception unique. Il ne doit probablement pas appartenir à ce monde.

refinements.1:
<v>Uniquement pour les joueurs sur :</v>
<v>« PlayStation™Network »</v>
Après avoir infligé des DGT Cryo aux ennemis, les DGT infligés par les attaques normales et chargées augmentent de 10 % pendant 6 s. Cet effet peut être cumulé 2 fois maximum. De plus, lorsque Aloy équipe le Predator, son ATQ augmente de 66 pts.
